fieldData.ai-tagline: One man's dream takes flight, leaving history in its wake
fieldData.ai-summary: A brilliant aeronautical engineer pursues his lifelong passion for designing beautiful aircraft, unaware that his creations will become instruments of war during Japan's darkest hours. His story explores the tragic tension between personal ambition and moral responsibility during one of history's most turbulent periods.

fieldData.ai-summary: This powerful drama follows Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. as he orchestrates a monumental journey from Selma to Montgomery, Alabama, fighting for voting rights and challenging the systemic racism that denied Black Americans their voice. Facing violent opposition and institutional resistance, King leads thousands on a transformative march that becomes a defining moment in the Civil Rights Movement. The film captures the courage, sacrifice, and moral conviction required to reshape a nation's conscience.
fieldData.name: Selma
